description.fr-FR: Quatrième volume de l’Année liturgique : la Septuagésime, de la Septuagésime au samedi après les Cendres, avec le Propre des saints de février et mars.
description.en-US: Volume 4 of the 15-volume Liturgical Year (L’Année liturgique) in the original French: Septuagesima. One chapter per day or feast, with the liturgical texts in Latin and French as the edition prints them.
description.pt-BR: Volume 4 dos 15 volumes de «O Ano Litúrgico» (L’Année liturgique) em francês: a Septuagésima. Um capítulo por dia ou festa, com os textos litúrgicos em latim e francês como a edição os imprime.

fr-FR.editor: Dom Prosper Guéranger, abbé de Solesmes (14th ed., Oudin)

sources.description: Dom Guéranger site (Societas pro canonizatione D. Guéranger), WordPress text of the 14th edition (1900). Split at each day or feast heading; verse kept as hard line breaks; footnotes renumbered per chapter.
sources.tierEvidence: Guéranger died in 1875; the text is the 19th-century edition transcribed.
